chapters.caption: Hatch plate: rounded corners and a round notch
Hatching › Volume: set the pattern to Chessboard
Field size sets the edge length of one chess field
Chessboard: neighbouring fields are turned by 90°
Next layer: the whole pattern turns by 67°
Stripes (overlap set to −0.3 mm here so the seams show)
Hexagon: three groups of cells at 0°, 60° and 120°
Offset: rings that follow the outline
